title: Version 17.13.7
body_markdown:
*Released May 13th, 2025*

| Top bug fixes | From the community |
| --- | --- |
| Fixed an issue in the modern query work item TFVC checkin-policy that prevented the project name from being retrieved. Additionally, fixed an issue in the forbidden patterns TFVC check-in policy that caused the patterns to be "forgotten" by the policy after it was created. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/TFVC-Policies-Storage-Updates---not-work/10888692) |

| Security advisories addressed | CVE |
| --- | --- |
| Access to ETW tracing not known by Admin installing VS on the machine | [**CVE-2025-32703**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-32703) |
| Remote Code Execution due to nuget package squatting | [**CVE-2025-32702**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-32702) |
| .NET - Spoofing - Elevation of Privilege in msbuild's DownloadFile tasks default behaviors | [**CVE-2025-26646**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-26646) |
body_html:
Released May 13th, 2025

Top bug fixes From the community
Fixed an issue in the modern query work item TFVC checkin-policy that prevented the project name from being retrieved. Additionally, fixed an issue in the forbidden patterns TFVC check-in policy that caused the patterns to be "forgotten" by the policy after it was created. Feedback ticket
Security advisories addressed CVE
Access to ETW tracing not known by Admin installing VS on the machine CVE-2025-32703
Remote Code Execution due to nuget package squatting CVE-2025-32702
.NET - Spoofing - Elevation of Privilege in msbuild's DownloadFile tasks default behaviors CVE-2025-26646
